title: Capture Product error envelopes verbatim in GLOBAL fixtures
body:
GLOBAL fixtures for `{ok:false}` task output exit 0, which Product never does (`src/task/cli.ts:89-108`): `test/hooks-guard.test.mjs:1452`, `test/opencode/krn-adapter.test.mjs:164`, `test/lane/publication-gate.test.mjs:20`, `test/lane/runner-contract.test.mjs` (review N7, KRN-12).
Acceptance: error fixtures are verbatim Product captures with their real exit codes, and consumers are tested on them.
